section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Image-Acceptance and Action Questionnaire (BI-AAQ), a 12-item scale measuring body image flexibility in response to negative body-related thoughts and feelings. The scale uses a 7-point rating system and has demonstrated good psychometric properties in US adults, including one-dimensional factor structure, good internal consistency, and test-retest reliability. In the present study, Cronbach's alpha values were .97 for women and .96 for men, indicating excellent internal consistency.
